_doc: How small fixings are bought: in packs, so a shopping list rounds a count up to whole packs and says how many are spare. kind as in x1c.json.
name: packs

pack.rule: Screws, nuts, washers and inserts up to M6 are bought in packs of 10: the shopping list rounds each count up to whole packs of this size and shows the spares. An estimate: sellers offer packs from 5 to 1000 (Spalding Fasteners lists 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 and more of an M3x8; Hi-Line and Zoro sell M3x8 cap screws by the 100), and 10 is a common small pack. Set your own where you buy
